jonah.1.p1.b2.text: Now the word of the LORD came to Jonah son of Amittai, saying,

jonah.1.p1.b3.text: “Get up! Go to the great city of Nineveh and preach against it, because its wickedness has come up before Me.”

jonah.1.p2.b1.text: Jonah, however, got up to flee to Tarshish, away from the presence of the LORD.

jonah.1.p2.b2.text: He went down to Joppa and found a ship bound for Tarshish.

jonah.1.p2.b3.text: So he paid the fare and went aboard to sail for Tarshish, away from the presence of the LORD.

jonah.1.p3.b1.text: Then the LORD hurled a great wind upon the sea, and such a violent storm arose that the ship was in danger of breaking apart.

jonah.1.p4.b1.text: The sailors were afraid, and each cried out to his own god. And they threw the ship’s cargo into the sea to lighten the load.

jonah.1.p4.b2.text: But Jonah had gone down to the lowest part of the vessel, where he lay down and fell into a deep sleep.

jonah.1.p4.b3.text: “How can you sleep? Get up and call upon your God. …

jonah.1.p4.b4.text: … Perhaps this God will consider us, so that we may not perish.”

jonah.1.p5.b1.text: So they cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.

jonah.1.p5.b2.text: “Tell us now,” … who is to blame for this calamity that is upon us? What is your occupation, and where have you come from? …

jonah.1.p5.b3.text: “I am a Hebrew,” … “I worship the LORD, the God of the heavens, who made the sea and the dry land.”

jonah.1.p6.b1.text: “What must we do to you to calm this sea for us?”

jonah.1.p6.b2.text: “Pick me up,” … “and cast me into the sea, so it may quiet down for you. For I know that I am to blame for this violent storm that has come upon you.”

jonah.1.p6.b3.text: Nevertheless, the men rowed hard to get back to dry land, but they could not, for the sea was raging against them more and more.

jonah.1.p7.b1.text: “Please, O LORD, do not let us perish on account of this man’s life! Do not charge us with innocent blood! …

jonah.1.p7.b2.text: At this, they picked up Jonah and cast him into the sea

jonah.1.p7.b4.text: Then the men feared the LORD greatly, and they offered a sacrifice to the LORD and made vows to Him.

jonah.1.p8.b1.text: Now the LORD had appointed a great fish to swallow Jonah

jonah.1.p8.b2.text: Jonah spent three days and three nights in the belly of the fish.
